text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: service-x v3.4.0 -> 5% traffic in eu-west at 2026-03-21T14:00Z. Change window: 14:00-15:00 UTC. Canary route: /generate. Commit: a1b2c3d.

amanda: pinging QA for quick smoke. lia please confirm test run scheduled?

lia: running smoke now on a 10k sample. will post failures in 2m.

raj: FYI routing policy set to weighted-shift, fallback to v3.3.9. autoscale config unchanged.

kevin: monitoring SLOs (p50/p95/p99). alert thresholds set to +20% latency / +2% error.

lia: smoke pass for 10k sample, 0.12% 5xx, mostly timeouts on long prompts. attaching sample log snippet:
```
2026-03-21T14:02:13Z service-x v3.4.0 request_id=xyz duration=512ms tokens=120
2026-03-21T14:02:14Z service-x v3.4.0 request_id=abc duration=5021ms tokens=512 error=deadline
```

amanda: timeout spikes are worrying. are those from a single host or across pool?

raj: initial scatter looks like 2 nodes seeing high tail for long sequences. digging into KV cache metrics.

kevin: infra shows NVMe read latencies bumped on those two hosts at the same time as the tails. I/O contention maybe.

oliver: ops hold? we need a quick go/no-go. Current plan was to wait 15m and ramp to 20%.

amanda: status? QA flagged prompts >400 tokens failing intermittently. proposal: pause ramp, pin remaining traffic to v3.3.9, and rotate the two hosts out for a restart.

raj: agree with pin. quick config to pin: `POST /admin/rollout/pin {"service":"service-x","version":"3.3.9"}`. deploy-bot can execute on ack.

deploy-bot: Runbook: To pin, run `deploy-bot pin service-x 3.3.9 --scope=eu-west --reason="canary tail latency"`. Confirm by replying `ack pin`.

lia: ack pin from QA side. will re-run smoke after pin and host restart.

kevin: ack pin from SRE. I'll start host rotation: `infractl drain --hosts host-12,host-18` then restart nvme driver. ETA 8-10min.

oliver: vote: amanda? raj? kevin? lia? please respond quick: go to pin + restart or let ramp continue?

amanda: vote = pin + restart.

raj: vote = pin + restart. if we don't pin we risk customer impact.

kevin: vote = pin + restart.

lia: vote = pin + restart. smoke must pass.

oliver: consensus reached: pin + restart. amanda, can you craft a short release note for support?

amanda: posting to #support: "Rolling back staged traffic for service-x to v3.3.9 in eu-west due to canary tail latency on long prompts. Engineers are restarting two hosts and will re-run QA. No customer-facing error spike observed yet; monitoring closely. ETA 20m."

deploy-bot: Performing pin now...

deploy-bot: Pin complete — traffic for service-x in eu-west set to v3.3.9. Rollout paused. Change: pinned_by=oliver reason="canary tail latency" pin_ts=4995551302

kevin: started drain on host-12 and host-18.

raj: root cause hypothesis: model kernel path plus NVMe GC on those instances causing KV lookup stalls for long sequences. will collect kernel logs.

lia: will re-run the 10k smoke after hosts are back.

amanda: support brief sent. monitoring channels open.

kevin: hosts restarted, NVMe latencies back to baseline.

lia: smoke re-run 10k sample: pass 99.98% with 0.02% timeouts (within baseline).

amanda: decision time: re-run canary ramp? propose resume to 10% then observe 10min before 20%.

oliver: quick vote to resume staged rollout to 10%? please reply `+1` to resume or `-1` to keep pinned.

amanda: +1

raj: +1

kevin: +1 (watching p99)

lia: +1 (QA good)

oliver: quorum met. deploy-bot, please unpin and ramp to 10% with a 10-minute hold.

deploy-bot: Unpinning and ramping to 10% now. Ramp plan: 5% -> 10% -> hold 10m. Rollout change_id=chg-4995551310.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 10% complete. Hold window starts.

kevin: monitoring shows no latency regressions at p95/p99 for 10m so far.

lia: QA quick sample green.

amanda: ok to continue to 20% after hold? propose auto-continue unless SLO breach > threshold.

oliver: agreed. we'll allow auto-continue with alert guardrails. tagging this thread as resolved for the pin action; continue monitoring for the next ramp step.

deploy-bot: Thread note: pin action resolved. Next scheduled ramp to 20% in 5m unless alerts fire.
